thread:
emily: quick heads-up — I noticed the API reference for POST /v1/chat/respond has an incorrect request schema. it lists "input" as a string but the runtime accepts an array of message objects (role/content). also the python example is using the old client.call(...) pattern.
jack: can you paste the exact snippet? i can open a small PR.
emily: sure — current doc shows: ```json
{
  "input": "hello",
  "max_tokens": 64
}
```
but runtime expects: ```json
{
  "input": [{ "role": "user", "content": "hello" }],
  "max_tokens": 64
}
```
priya: wow good catch. the response schema is also outdated: it still shows a single "message" string. we return an object with "message" and "alternatives" array + "consumed_tokens" meta. docs-ci: build failed on latest main because of mismatch tests referencing the old example. link: https://ci.internal/docs/9876
maria: i'll own the PR if someone posts the exact fixes we need. is there a migration note to add for customers who relied on string input?
emily: migration note: say that API now accepts message arrays and support for plain string input is deprecated — will keep for 2 minor releases but behavior will be converted to single message array. add a small example how to convert legacy call.
jack: ok i'll open a PR updating: 1) request schema type for input -> array[message], 2) response schema to include "alternatives" (array of {message, score}) and "consumed_tokens" (object), 3) python + node snippets to use new sdk.chat.create(...) pattern, 4) add migration note & curl example.
ken: for the python snippet make sure to include streaming example too — many customers copy that. something like:
```python
from redwood import RedwoodClient
client = RedwoodClient()
resp = client.chat.create(input=[{"role":"user","content":"Summarize PR 123"}], stream=True)
for chunk in resp:
    print(chunk.delta)
```
alex: also update the OpenAPI schema file in repo (openapi/chat.yaml) so generated SDKs pick this up. i'll handle that part once PR is up.
emily: one more: the curl example currently posts Content-Type: application/json but uses the old body shape. change to: ```bash
curl -X POST https://api.redwood.ai/v1/chat/respond 
 -H "Authorization: Bearer $TOKEN" 
 -H "Content-Type: application/json" 
 -d '{"input":[{"role":"user","content":"hi"}],"max_tokens":64}'
```
priya: can we also add an example mapping for customers using the legacy string form? tiny snippet: ```js
// legacy: { input: "hello" }
// new: { input: [{ role: 'user', content: 'hello' }] }
```
maria: PR opened: https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/432 — added schema + examples + migration note. tagging @jack for review.
jack: reviewing now. left one inline about call signature naming (chat.create vs chat.respond) — we standardised on chat.create in SDKs.
emily: after merge can someone trigger the docs build and check the example smoke tests? docs-ci: please re-run job 9876 when PR merges.
docs-ci: queued rerun for job 9876 (awaiting merge). :ok_hand:
ken: once merged i'll add the streaming snippet into the streaming guide and link from the API ref.
alex: i'll update openapi and run the sdk-generation pipeline, then notify teams if any language bindings change.
priya: tiny nit — add a note in the examples that "alternatives" is experimental and may reorder.
emily: perfect. thanks everyone — this should fix the CI noise and stop customers from copying broken examples. :raised_hands:
